authenticationCheck.scheme: Numen MCP bearer token, token store config/numen/server/mcp_tokens.json (sha256 of the token, role, owner, scope, expiry)

officialIssuance.headlessAttempt: The offline client sent `numen token create brain` itself through the chat_command packet as an operator; the server answered command.unknown.command, so a real Minecraft client is required for official issuance.
officialIssuance.fallback: One locally written BRAIN entry was added to the token store with the same hash format. It is loopback-only, documented here, and is not a secret that protects anything beyond this disposable world.
officialIssuance.rcon: RCON is loopback-only with a lab password; it is not exposed beyond 127.0.0.1.

method.driver: Numen MCP tools/call lua with a fixed program; no language model in the loop
method.why: The published evidence could not separate 'the model never fed the depot' from 'the native call cannot reach the depot top face'.

trials.verdict: fail - exact reproduction of the historical request 19 receipt
fail - the item argument alone does not help

trials.stance: -0.5,-59,5.5 (feet one block higher, eye above the depot top)
trials.depotAfter: HeldItem minecraft:iron_ingot, then create:iron_sheet after pressing

findings: Stance height, not the call shape, decides whether the depot receives the item. With the eye at or below the depot top surface the right-click produces no effect; one block higher it succeeds.
The item argument is not required for success and does not fix the low stance. gear.hold plus a bare use.block works once the stance is right.
The historical failure at requests 19, 23, 31 and 33 is therefore reproduced by geometry and stance alone, without any model involvement.
The earlier statement that the interface 'cannot specify the hit face' remains true as an API description, but it is not the cause of the observed failure.
limits: The rebuilt press used a creative motor at +16 RPM instead of the original water wheel, eleven gearboxes and +8 RPM chain, so this is not a same-condition reproduction.
The exact stance used by the model was not recorded; the low stance here is an inference from the floor geometry, not measured evidence.
The world is a new minimal fixture, not the original variant-ready-world.
Two trials per cell; this is a mechanism demonstration, not a success-rate measurement.
nextSteps: Record stance height in the Skill or the survey receipt so the companion checks its eye level against the depot top before feeding.
Re-run one model trial only after the stance fact is available, and keep separating build, self-verification and independent acceptance.
